summary: Aura Biosciences filed an 8-K disclosing a stock purchase agreement with Matrix Capital Management Master Fund, LP to repurchase up to 6,922,870 shares (all held by Matrix) at $5.64 per share, the same price as the concurrent equity offering. The repurchase is conditioned on closing of that offering and funded from net proceeds exceeding $200M. The transaction, approved by the audit committee, reduces Matrix's ~10.8% stake. Shares become authorized but unissued. The expected closing is no earlier than two business days after the equity offering's close. Watch for the equity offering's completion as a condition precedent.
